design: Original 80 retained. Add 9 original-wrong and 3 original-correct per model/type, sampling without replacement from remaining eligible pairs; exclude all prior-selected pairs across overlapping types. Sequential type/model strata, fixed 12 wrong + 4 correct per model/type in final set. Conditional extension probabilities only; not independent SRS of the full final population. Descriptive type counts use designated target_type. No population prevalence inference.
